name: chrome-browser-mcp
description: Real-session AI browser control for Chrome, Arc, Brave & Edge — hybrid Content Script + on-demand CDP, WebMCP, Prompt-Injection Shield, Workflow Recorder, and Browser Control Deck UI.

interface.shortDescription: Control your real logged-in Chrome tabs with a live Control Deck
interface.longDescription: Drive your real Chrome, Arc, Brave, or Edge profile over MCP v2 without losing sessions or showing a permanent debugger banner. Includes the interactive Browser Control Deck in Codex's global sidebar and thread side panel, WebMCP discovery, Prompt-Injection Shield, and recorded workflow replay.
defaultPrompt: Open the Browser Control Deck and list my connected browser tabs
Check the active tab for console errors and failed network requests
Discover WebMCP tools available on the current page and run a quick a11y audit
